rows.onlyTwoWrites: This packet writes two facts — the county and the case number — and that is the honest maximum for this form rather than a shortfall. MC 227a has no separate name, address or telephone field: it has one free-text box captioned 'Defendant's name, address, and telephone no.', and everything else on it is a court or police record fact (judicial district, judicial circuit, ORI, court address, court telephone number, police report number, CTN/TCN, SID) or the conviction table, which the form's own instruction 4 says to get from the court. A reviewer opening the raster will see a nearly empty page; this is why.
notableDecisions: The certificate of mailing at the foot of page 1 is left entirely blank. It is declared under the penalties of perjury and the court's own instruction sheet puts it at step 8, after the packet has been mailed at step 7. The participant instructions carry those four steps in the court's order, because the order is the point.

No cell of the four-row conviction table is written: instruction 4 says the exact date and charge come from the court and that a certified copy of each conviction must be attached, and the platform holds neither.

The `dinfo` box asks for name, address and telephone number in one free-text block. The platform holds all three separately and the shared registry has no composed contact fact, so a field — which binds one fact — could write at most one of the three. It is left to the participant with the reason stated, rather than putting a third of an answer in the box the court reads for contact details.
findingsRaisedForOthers: The shared semantic registry has no composed participant contact fact, which is what MC 227a's `dinfo` box needs. scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs is outside this lane's owned paths and was read, never edited.

scripts/build-census-v1-mi-setaside-marihuana-set.mjs (hyphenated) also writes this family's overlay directory and predates this lane. PF16 owns the underscored name and the directory; this build supersedes what that script produced and the two must not both be run. Removing or redirecting the other script is the Captain's call, not this lane's.

BLOCKING for the raster gate, owner of the packet-factory builder contract: assembled packet PDFs are NOT byte-reproducible. PDFDocument.create() stamps /CreationDate and /ModDate from the wall clock, and save({updateMetadata:false}) stops those being refreshed but not being set. Two builds of identical inputs were measured differing in exactly six bytes, all of them timestamp digits. A RASTER_PASS bound to one build's SHA-256 is therefore invalidated by a rebuild that changed nothing, which is the opposite of what a hash-bound gate is for. The fix is two lines before save: setCreationDate(new Date(0)) and setModificationDate(new Date(0)). This lane applied it to the three families no VF lane has been assigned, and proved reproducibility by rebuilding and comparing. It did NOT apply it to its earlier families: VF-SRC-A and VF-SRC-B are reading those now, and moving bytes under a verifier mid-read is worse than leaving a known non-determinism in place for the Captain to sequence.

rows.statutoryAuthority: AS 22.35.030; Alaska Administrative Rule 40(a); Alaska Court System form TF-810 (5/25)
notableDecisions: TF-810 is a correction request, not a petition: the form states that its ten grounds are removals the court system performs automatically and that the form exists for a requester who believes the court made an error. There is no verification, no certificate of service and no proposed order on it, and the packet does not invent any.

All ten printed grounds are participant elections. The packet is built for Administrative Rule 40(a) and AS 22.35.030; ticking a ground would assert a disposition the platform does not hold. Grounds 4 and 9 each require an attachment the platform does not have, and the instructions say so in the form's own terms.

The widget named `partyNames` is the CASE NAME box, and the grounds printed as 9 and 10 are marked by widgets named `Check Box8.1` and `Check Box8.2`. Field names are not a reliable channel on this form; every caption is read off the page at the widget's own coordinate and re-checked on each build, and both mismatches are recorded in the field census.

MASTER_QUEUE.json now binds all four PRB forms by exact SHA-256 — a real advance over the previous PF16 cohort, which found the labels identified no document at all — but it binds them to Google Drive locators, not to files. The committed acquisition return that produced those hashes records sourceBodiesCommittedToApplicationRepository: 0 and failureClassification PRIVATE_UPLOAD_BLOCKED_AFTER_ACQUISITION, so the bodies were acquired into a Codex staging root and an owner-only Drive folder and never reached this repository. The builder contract's first item is to bind every source by exact SHA-256 and stop the family rather than build on a source that does not bind, so the family stops.

thePleadingSideWasNotBuiltEither.whyThisNeedsSaying: This family's strategy is custom_pleading, so a reader may reasonably ask why the three required pleading components were not composed and the family returned partially built. They were not, for two reasons, and neither is 'the lane ran out of time'.
thePleadingSideWasNotBuiltEither.first: Rendering the pleading components while the required DOJ CRISS component stayed missing would produce an overlay directory that reads as a built family with a missing companion form. thePleadingSideWasNotBuiltEither.second: Composing them would require legal design this lane does not hold. All three carry outputStrategyStatus null in the registry, and the route-obligation census records this route's signatureRequirements, notarizationRequirements, affidavitOrVerification, serviceMethod, serviceTiming, filingMethod, filingFee, feeWaiverTreatment, laterCompletionFields, schedulesOrContinuationPages, coverSheet, notice, filingDeadline, postFilingInstructions, waitingPeriodCalculation, uncontestedHearingTreatment and contestedHearingOrOppositionHandoff all as 'not_recorded'. laneNote: The Captain rebased shiftBaseSha to 2e6ca51b at 09:51:26Z, after this lane's families were built on the previous base 09b741ad. The shared machinery this lane depends on is unchanged between the two: completeness-contract.mjs, the finalizer, the field semantics, the anchor capture, the rule lines and the corpus index are all identical, so the counters in these rows were computed against the same contract the new base carries. What DID change is that scripts/lib/pdf-page-raster.mjs moved; see findingsRaisedForOthers. This branch was not reset onto the new base, because resetting would discard five commits of finished, pushed returns and the rebase reason given in the shift file — verifiers rebasing onto a base missing the integration waves — does not apply to a builder whose preflight already reads 15/15.
